'''Lind Taglien''' is the innkeeper of [[the Great Gathering]] in the [[Black Tower]]. Her husband is [[Frask]]. 

==Description==
She is short with dark hair. Her dress has lovely embroidery.

==Activities==
Lind and Frask run the Great Gathering inn in the Black Tower. They help Androl and his friends when the Taim's cronies bullied them. 

After [[Welyn]] returns, having being [[Turned]], she is highly suspicious of his change of heart and considers having Frask follow him until Androl persuades her to simply keep an eye on Welyn and report anything strange he does. 

==Trivia==
Lind Taglien is a tribute to Linda Taglieri of the [[The Thirteenth Depository]]
